decision.reason: [ev-737d1d7d8334] contains only the PR title "chore: promote v1" under the BREAKING CHANGES heading. It doesn't name which API group, kinds or component "v1" refers to, and it doesn't say what "promote" means, such as served or storage version, or whether an older version was removed. It also doesn't say what breaks for an operator who does nothing. To write the assertion, we need the PR #4635 description or diff, or an upgrade-guide section covering this change.
